## The claim

P4-30: at least one converging approved drug survives every iteration-4 check for this child

**Prediction if true.** At least one drug named by 2 or more generators (P4-29) passes all three checks: (a) it is not in an iteration-4 do-not class (checkpoint-kinase inhibitors, Mps1/TTK and Aurora, measured less effective in aneuploid lines by entry 151; spindle poisons carried as a caution, not an exclusion); (b) it is not flagged by both safety sources for this child when entry 152's method is re-run on the iteration-4 candidate set; (c) where PRISM measures it, its effect does not point against the direction it is proposed for (Cliff's delta below 0 with one-sided p < 0.05 in the opposite direction)

**What would refute it.** Every converging drug fails at least one of the three checks, or no drug converges
